title: Theme Controller: Theme Controller using a toggle with icons (daisyUI)
notes:
If a checked checkbox input or a checked radio input with theme-controller class exists in the page, The page will have the same theme as that input's value.

Needs daisyUI installed (npm i -D daisyui, then @plugin "daisyui" in your CSS).

Original file: https://github.com/saadeghi/daisyui/blob/master/packages/docs/src/routes/(routes)/components/theme-controller/+page.md
code:
<label class="flex cursor-pointer gap-2">
  <svg
    xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
    width="20"
    height="20"
    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
    fill="none"
    stroke="currentColor"
    stroke-width="2"
    stroke-linecap="round"
    stroke-linejoin="round">
    <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="5" />
    <path
      d="M12 1v2M12 21v2M4.2 4.2l1.4 1.4M18.4 18.4l1.4 1.4M1 12h2M21 12h2M4.2 19.8l1.4-1.4M18.4 5.6l1.4-1.4" />
  </svg>
  <input type="checkbox" value="synthwave" class="toggle theme-controller" />
  <svg
    xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
    width="20"
    height="20"
    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
    fill="none"
    stroke="currentColor"
    stroke-width="2"
    stroke-linecap="round"
    stroke-linejoin="round">
    <path d="M21 12.79A9 9 0 1 1 11.21 3 7 7 0 0 0 21 12.79z"></path>
  </svg>
</label>
